title: Bowler bag on a rain-beaded bonnet

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. The cherry-red bowler bag sits on the polished cream bonnet of a parked 1960s saloon after rain, beads of water standing on the paint and on the leather, a chrome bonnet emblem left unlettered. Grey Parisian street softly out of focus behind, wet cobbles reflecting a pale sky. 85mm from bonnet height, the bag filling the middle of the frame, its handle crisp.
